Hey Isabella, I've been meaning to ask you about the Valentine’s Day event. Eddy mentioned it and said they could use some help setting things up. I'm happy to lend a hand if there's anything specific you need.
Isabella Rodriguez
Hi Klaus, it’s great to see you. I’d love your help setting up; there are a few things that could use an extra pair of hands. Also, if you can stay for the event with us, that would be wonderful!
Klaus Mueller
Sure, I'd be glad to help out and stay for the event. When would you like me to come in tomorrow?
Isabella Rodriguez
That would be fantastic, Klaus. How about coming around mid-morning when there are fewer customers? We can start by going through some of the preparations and decorations together.
Klaus Mueller
Sounds good, Isabella. I'll be there around 10 AM then. Let me know if anything changes or if you need help with anything specific before then.
Isabella Rodriguez
That works for me, Klaus. I'll have some supplies and decorations ready by then. And if you could stay a bit longer to help with last-minute touches before we open, that would be really helpful.
Klaus Mueller
Sure thing, Isabella. I'll make sure to be there early and stay as long as needed. See you tomorrow!
Isabella Rodriguez
Thank you so much, Klaus. Your help will really make a difference. Have a good evening and I'll see you bright and early tomorrow.
Klaus Mueller
No problem, Isabella. I'll bring some extra decorations or supplies if you think we might need them. Talk to you tomorrow!
Isabella Rodriguez
That would be wonderful, Klaus. Thanks for being so accommodating and bringing extra supplies if you can. I’m looking forward to working with you tomorrow.
Klaus Mueller
Sounds great, Isabella. I'll make sure to bring some supplies and decorations tomorrow morning. Have a nice evening!
Isabella Rodriguez
It means a lot to me, Klaus. Your support really helps lighten my load.
Klaus Mueller
Thanks, Isabella. I’ll see you at 10 AM tomorrow to start setting everything up. Have a great night!
